title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 2004: First self detonation (3)

section.p: After transforming into a humanoid form clad in golden robes, the golden crow looked around cautiously and said, “There are unwritten rules here. Nobody should force their way into a sealed location. My place of cultivation is protected by formations. Why did you break my formations and force me out of my seclusion?”
He sounded furious. However, he did not show any hostility. After all, he was surrounded by too many experts.
Venerable Moon smiled and said, “I guess we need to produce some willpower fragments to explain everything to the newly awakened friends. This will simplify things a lot.”
He appeared a lot more polite toward this expert compared to the ape expert they found earlier. A beam of willpower was sent over. Shortly after, understanding dawned on the golden crow.
His eyes flickered. Had things changed so much in the Upper Realm? The chaos race and Torchbearers had appeared out of nowhere?
After learning about all that, he stopped his protest and said, “In that case, I’ll go to the Myriad Race Mountain and take a look at those from my race.”
Then, he left without any hesitation. He was quite worried about his race. He had a feeling that his race had weakened considerably during his time in seclusion.
“Golden Fire Marquis.”

Looking at the departing golden crow, the skeletal figure said, “This bird is very proficient in the path of true fire. He has the ability to burn everything. Back then, he was one of the top experts of the golden crow race. How many pseudo kings does the golden crow race still have?”
Su Yu said, “Including him? One. Excluding him? Zero.”
“Is that so? The golden crows were very powerful back then. They were actually slightly stronger than the iron devourers. Looks like everything has changed.”

He added, “So that’s Eclipse Moon Marquis? No wonder his aura feels so familiar. But he has grown much stronger than before. Since he’s still alive, I wonder if his brother, Corona Marquis, is still around as well.”
Su Yu raised his brow, “He has a brother?”
“Yes. The brother was even stronger than him.”

With a pensive look, Su Yu said, “In that case, the brother might still be alive. Of the three major races, the other two still have two Venerables each. The divine race is the only race with one Venerable. They might still have one hidden away or the immortal and devil races wouldn’t have bothered to share power with them. The two might be aware of this hidden expert.”
The skeletal figure said nothing about that. He looked toward the depths of the Dao Origin Land again and said, “Are you waiting here to save the humans they might find?”

“No. I’m here to get a good look at the hidden experts of the myriad races. I am too weak to even dream of saving anyone. You’re seeing this as well, right? They have six Venerables, four heavenly kings, and twelve Daofuses here. I can’t save anyone from such a force.”
The skeletal figure said, “If possible, please do lend them a hand, young friend…”
“We’ll worry about this later.”
The skeletal figure felt quite helpless at Su Yu’s indifference. This youngster seemed too unfeeling. He had yet to obtain any useful information from this youngster.
Just then, Su Yu licked his lips and said, “It’s time for the show. They’re going to find the other bird soon.”
The golden crow had left, but Su Yu noticed that March’s group was going to encounter the other bird soon.
Very good.

As for March, he would be fine. Despite his looks, he was incredibly shrewd. He was barely putting any effort into this, letting Venerable Scrape take the lead in the search. Thus, Venerable Scrape would be the one to be faced with any danger during their search as well.
At the same time.
Once again, the Myriad Power Tower near Venerable Scrape lit up. Venerable Scrape flew forward and slapped his palm down in a well-practiced manner. A weak aura started surging from the underground.
Venerable Scrape sent his willpower deep underground. Before long, he saw an awakening bird.
At the sight of that bird, he greeted with surprise, “Nine-winged race. You’re the Bonewing Marquis.”
The bird was someone he knew. The nine-winged race was near extinction. Thus, he was quite surprised to find the Bonewing Marquis alive.
Deep underground, Bonewing Marquis opened his eyes. He looked up blankly, but shortly after, he regained his clarity of mind. “It’s Fellow Daoist Scrape.”
The bird spoke slowly. For the most part, the myriad race experts would not attack each other for no good reason. The bird could feel the numerous powerful auras around him.
After a slight hesitation, he soared into the sky and reestablished his connection to his dao. He asked doubtfully, “Fellow Daoist, why did you break through my place of cultivation?”
“You are not aware of this, but…”
Venerable Scrape gave the bird a short explanation of what was happening. Understanding dawned on the bird. So that was why.
At that point, he was already fully reconnected to his dao. Suddenly, an intense rage entered his mind.
“Slaughter.”
“Slaughter everyone.”
“Kill! Kill! Kill!”
Su Yu’s trap erupted.
The turbid eyes of Bonewing Marquis turned blood-red as madness consumed his being. When he looked at Venerable Scrape again, he felt as though he was looking at someone who had killed his parents.
Meeting Bonewing Marquis’ gaze, Venerable Scrape blanked out.
What was going on?
Then, an intense murderous intent surged. A gigantic wing sliced through the air and shot toward Venerable Scrape.
Venerable Scrape hurriedly pulled back before roaring in fury, “Bonewing, are you mad?”
Bonewing Marquis was attacking him! What madness was this? March, who was about to approach them, stopped doubtfully. What was going on? Well, it didn’t matter. He only needed to enjoy the show.
Meanwhile, Bonewing Marquis had lost his mind. He charged forth and attacked with all his strength while roaring with boundless fury and madness.
“Die!”
Instantly, a battle erupted between him and Venerable Scrape. The furious Venerable Scrape roared again, “You’re courting death!”
Was this fellow mad? Why was this guy attacking when he hadn’t even done anything? Was this guy trying to die? Did this guy believe that he wouldn’t dare to kill here?
With a wave of his arm, a massive devil projection appeared in the sky before pressing down upon Bonewing Marquis. How could the newly awakened Bonewing Marquis be a match for a Venerable like him?
Venerable Scrape demanded, “What are you doing? Did you lose your mind during our seclusion?”

Venerable Scrape suspected that Bonewing Marquis had suffered from cultivation deviation due to his long seclusion. The intensely struggling Bonewing Marquis was quite difficult to suppress, especially since he was trying to capture the marquis alive.
“March!”

He shouted for March’s help. With March’s assistance, this would be easier. It was quite likely that Bonewing Marquis was suffering from a cultivation deviation. He could see the blood-red eyes of Bonewing Marquis.
Was this a side-effect of cultivating a fake dao? Sure enough, the fake daos were very problematic.
At this point, the surrounding experts had arrived as well. A heavenly king said, “Venerable, we’ll help!”

Venerable Scrape nodded while cursing March inwardly. Damn that bastard! He was still dragging his feet! Further away, Venerable Moon and the others looked over curiously, but none bothered to move toward them. They had more than enough people to handle a newly awakened pseudo king.
At the same time.
Su Yu grinned and said, “Boom! Give them a nice gift!”

The skeletal figure couldn’t help but stare at Su Yu and his villainous smile. That was quite an uncomfortable smile to look at. Right at that moment, the eyes of the suppressed Bonewing Marquis reached the peak of their intensity.
“You asked for this! Die! All of you! Die!”
With a roar, a massive explosion erupted. The bird had self-detonated.
Fireworks bloomed in the sky.
A heavenly king had self-detonated out of nowhere. This might only be a fake dao cultivator for Su Yu, but this was a proper heavenly king for anyone else.
The powerful explosion sent even Venerable Scrape flying far away while coughing blood with a confused look in his eyes.
Self-detonation?
That was true madness.
Next, Venerable Scrape’s expression changed. That explosion had destroyed the body of a heavenly king. The heavenly king survived, but the two Daofuses behind the heavenly king had been killed.
Not even their seas of willpower had survived.
Two additional fireworks bloomed in the sky.
Two Daofuses had died just like that, and a heavenly king had been heavily injured.
“Damn it!”
Venerable Scrape was furious.
When he glared at March, March said blankly, “I didn’t expect him to detonate himself…”
Why was this guy looking at him?

How was he supposed to know that would happen? Did this guy know that in advance? No, right? Venerable Scrape was so infuriated he nearly coughed more blood from sheer anger. Yes. Not even he had expected that.
Weren’t they in the middle of a friendly discussion?
Damn it!
Why did that bird detonate himself so suddenly?
The others were alarmed as well. Venerable Moon asked, “What happened?”
“Why did Bonewing Marquis self-detonate?
A heavenly king and two Daofuses had died. Why did that marquis self-detonate out of nowhere?
“Cultivation deviation from prolonged seclusion.”

Venerable Scrape concluded while gritting his teeth in anger. He did not suspect anything. He was merely blaming his bad luck for that. He was simply the unlucky guy to encounter someone in the middle of cultivation deviation.
He became even more certain that the fake daos were greatly problematic. Regular cultivators wouldn’t suffer from cultivation deviation so easily at the level of a heavenly king.
Meanwhile, Su Yu had a regretful expression.
Fuck!
That explosion had only injured a heavenly king and killed two Daofuses. How regretful. Why didn’t that detonation kill the heavenly king as well?
Beside him, the eyes of the skeletal figure flickered. It was this guy!
He stared at Su Yu, certain that Su Yu was the culprit. How was it done?
How ruthless.
